entries.label: 4候補の規定形とのずれ・出所束縛の生存（機械診断）
argv:
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
targets = [".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-contract-014-canonical-sequence-gaps-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-launch-metrics-acceptance-title-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-doc-drift-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-vocabulary-001--v1.json"]
config = json.load(open('config/development-issue-resolution-pilot-v3.json', encoding='utf-8'))
expected = set(config['record_fields']['improvement_candidate'])
allowed_classifications = set(config['classification_candidates'])
allowed_routes = set(config['dispositions'])
for target in targets:
    document = json.loads(Path(target).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    print(Path(target).name)
    print('  extra_fields', sorted(set(document) - expected))
    print('  missing_fields', sorted(expected - set(document)))
    source = document.get('source_identity', {})
    print('  source_identity_keys', sorted(source))
    print('  invalid_classifications', sorted(set(document.get('classification_candidates', [])) - allowed_classifications))
    print('  invalid_routes', sorted(set(document.get('route_candidates', [])) - allowed_routes))
    source_path = Path(str(source.get('path', '')))
    exists = source_path.is_file()
    print('  source_exists', exists)
    if exists:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        print('  source_sha256_matches', digest == source.get('sha256'))
    refs = document.get('evidence_refs', [])
    for reference in refs:
        ref_path = Path(str(reference.get('path', '')))
        ok = ref_path.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(ref_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == reference.get('sha256')
        print('  evidence_ref', ref_path.name, 'binding_ok', ok)

entries.label: 4候補の登録履歴（初回commit・改版数）
argv:
import subprocess
targets = [".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-contract-014-canonical-sequence-gaps-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-launch-metrics-acceptance-title-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-doc-drift-001--v1.json", ".reviewcompass/workflow/improvement-candidates/ic-session-log-exit-code-vocabulary-001--v1.json"]
for target in targets:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ['git', 'log', '--format=%h %ad', '--date=short', '--reverse', '--', target],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    lines = completed.stdout.strip().splitlines()
    first = lines[0] if lines else '(履歴なし)'
    print(target.rsplit('/', 1)[-1], '初回commit', first, '改版数', len(lines))
